newsitem.title: USA: Atchison 3.8 mln share offer priced $15.50.
newsitem.headline: Atchison 3.8 mln share offer priced $15.50.

text.p: Atchison Casting Corp on Thursday said 3.8 million shares of its common stock were being offered at $15.50 each.
The company, which announced the offer April 14, said it was selling 2,029,024 shares and that a selling stockholder would sell 1,770,976 shares.
Atchison did not identify the stockholder and no one at the company was immediately available for further comment.

The company, which produces iron, steel and non-ferrous castings, said Smith Barney and George K. Baum & Co were managing underwriters for the offering. It said the underwriters were granted an over-allotment option to buy up to 570,000 additional shares from the company.
Net proceeds are to be used to reduce bank debt and fund future acquisitions, the company said.
